Here are some major office furniture brand websites across different categories:

## **Premium/High-End Brands**
- **Herman Miller** - hermanmiller.com
- **Steelcase** - steelcase.com
- **Knoll** - knoll.com
- **Haworth** - haworth.com
- **Humanscale** - humanscale.com

## **Mid-Range Commercial Brands**
- **HON** - hon.com
- **Global Furniture Group** - globalfurnituregroup.com
- **KI** - ki.com
- **Kimball** - kimballinternational.com
- **Allsteel** - allsteel.com

## **Budget-Friendly Options**
- **IKEA Business** - ikea.com/us/en/ikea-business/
- **Bush Business Furniture** - bushbusinessfurniture.com
- **Sauder** - sauder.com
- **Realspace** (Office Depot brand) - officedepot.com

## **Standing Desk Specialists**
- **Uplift Desk** - upliftdesk.com
- **Fully** - fully.com
- **Vari** - vari.com
- **FlexiSpot** - flexispot.com

## **Modern/Design-Focused**
- **West Elm Workspace** - westelm.com/pages/workspace/
- **Poppin** - poppin.com
- **Branch** - branchfurniture.com
- **Burrow** - burrow.com

These websites typically offer product catalogs, design tools, and resources for both individual and commercial buyers.
